title: It Felt Worse Than It Was
speaker: Figuring Out Money host

macro_themes.view: CPI came in hotter than expected and triggered a downside trend day, ending a 53-session streak without a 1% drop.
Money is rotating out of AI/semis into healthcare, staples and energy, with growth now underperforming value.
Only 23% of Nasdaq Composite stocks are above their 20-day; a bear strong environment under the gamma flip opens the door to bigger swings both ways.
TLT reversed from its lower to upper daily implied move in a flight to safety; if bonds rip while stocks fall, it could echo the 2018 Q4 selloff.
S&P has gone nowhere for about 3 months with bearish RSI/MACD divergences, despite Q4 seasonality usually being bullish.

calls.condition: To be more bullish, the market needs to recover and hold above the gamma flip line; a break below the weekly expected move could bring dealer-driven selling, and a pullback to the 7500 area would erase gains since May-June.
calls.reason: Price sits at the lower weekly expected move where it has 'doodled' or bounced for weeks, but it is below the declining 5-day MA and the gamma flip in a bear strong regime with weak breadth.
calls.quote: it's very common to doodle around, but if we start breaking and there's another catalyst... just be on guard

calls.reason: Reports in the morning with an implied earnings move of roughly 410-450; has sold off in a waterfall, which often precedes snap-back bounces.
calls.quote: The market is pricing in a move to and around 450 down to and around 410.

calls.condition: Bounce trade off expected-move levels; beware short sellers reloading at a lower high.
calls.reason: Semis fell from 640 to 560 very quickly; rubber-band logic favors a snap-back rally, but the structure is a lower high, so not to new highs.
calls.quote: why would you short it down here when it got there very quickly?

calls.condition: Expect follow-through lower first (lower daily implied move), then a bounce; better entry after a 20-30% rally and pullback.
calls.reason: Dropped from 50 to 30, down 12% on volume closing at the lows; falling knife likely to bounce soon but size small.
calls.quote: to see some sort of a bounce in the near future in a name like this. Yeah. Yeah. Very, very highly likelihood to happen.

calls.condition: If rates come off or consolidate.
calls.reason: Homebuilders sold off then closed at session highs as yields reversed lower, a bullish reversal day negatively correlated to the 10-year.
calls.quote: that little capitulatory day might lead to some bullish price action in the near term

calls.condition: If this is an early turn as rates come off.
calls.reason: Broke a downtrend line on good volume and is consolidating sideways; early stage, not yet a good chart.
calls.quote: if this is an early turn, right, you might be able to catch some decent moves into the end of Q4

calls.condition: If it continues out of its consolidation.
calls.reason: Up 2% on a down day, consolidating after a post-earnings rip, with relative strength all year.
calls.quote: if we're going to get continuation, we might want to try to target back up into around 170

calls.reason: Tight pattern broke out up 3% to a likely new year-to-date high, part of defensive strength (WMT, COST also).
calls.quote: today it was up right 3% and we started to see a little bit of a breakout
